decision: 10 second time penalty. 1 penalty points (total of 3 for the 12 month period).
fact: Failure to slow for a single yellow flag in Turn 3.
offence: Breach of Article B1.8.4a of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video, timing, telemetry and in-car video evidence. Car 30 passed a single yellow flag without discernibly reducing speed although also receiving a visible warning on the dash. As the infringement was not considered dangerous or egregious, a penalty on the lower end of the available scale is imposed.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 30 Failure To Follow For Yellow Flags
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
